title: lua: Register new ProtoFields and ProtoExperts in Evaluate window
description:
Call Proto_commit in the Evaluate window after completing the chunk,
to register ProtoFields and ProtoExperts.

In Proto_commit, if the Proto's ProtoFields were already registered,
ignore the Proto. This avoids errors about duplicate fields for
everything in the plugins already loaded at startup (or for previous
Evaluate statements.)

In Proto_set_fields and Proto_set_experts, if the Proto has already
registered its fields, add the new ones. Note that we have to
deregister the old ones for resons mentioned in
proto_register_field_array.

I believe we shouldn't have Proto_commit at all, but always do the
registration in Proto_set_fields and Proto_set_experts.

Also note that Proto.fields = {...} and Proto.experts = {...}
during a script have always added new fields/eis to the table of
those register rather than replacing the existing table. I'm not
sure that makes sense, but it's what has been done so I'm hesistant
to change the behavior.

Fix #17296
